[[File:Darth Grader Tour of the Sets Premiere still.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Darth Grader. Still: Darth Grader.]]
'''Mark M''' (YouTube '''Darth Grader''') is a collector and grader of ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game cards.<ref name="yt-7EVzszpRN_4" /> He runs the Darth Grader YouTube channel.<ref name="ch" />

He started grading in 2019 after looking up a first-edition Pokémon Charizard.<ref name="yt-7EVzszpRN_4" /> While going through childhood cards he found his old Star Wars CCG cards, which he collected before Pokémon, and submitted mains to PSA.<ref name="yt-7EVzszpRN_4" /> Bulk grading then cost about $8 to $10 a card.<ref name="yt-7EVzszpRN_4" /> The channel's first video, ''A Tour of the Sets - Premiere'', was posted on 9 February 2021.<ref name="yt-FoaSOdY-tpU" />
